gap_detail: Offline regression-tool defect found during the dry-run latency investigation; this is not a diagnosis of a landed or rejected economic opportunity.

evidence.scope: shared JSON execution testkit, no chain execution or broadcast
evidence.independent_review: legacy_callers read-only in-memory mutation of opcode 3: removing equality left legacy under/over-debit assert.throws passing via the test postcondition; typed VM rejection assertion fails correctly.
evidence.positive_control: Original nine balance/native fault controls continue to reject; malformed program, host errors and impossible native balance fixtures cannot supply VM guard evidence.
evidence.historical_execution: not-run; missing per-case bindings kept incomplete

tooling_defect.issue: Unqualified assert.throws around execution plus postcondition assertions treats a test assertion failure as a successful VM rejection.
tooling_defect.evidence: Independent removal of the equality instruction distinguishes the runtime guard error from the later balance assertion, but the old negative test accepted both.
tooling_defect.codify_target: Typed equality/uint256-range errors in the independent test interpreter, exact-code negative assertions, missing-guard controls and all-installed-JSON regression rounds.

replay_gate.expected_transition: Removing equality must fail debit negatives; ordinary VM guards still pass, and unrelated host/fixture failures are not rejection evidence.
